issues.title: Links should expire after a configurable TTL
issues.body: Marketing wants campaign links to stop working after the campaign ends. Add an optional TTL in hours when creating a link; expired links should resolve to 404.
issues.author: alice

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Implemented in shortlink/expiry.py, all timestamps in UTC.

issues.title: Rate limiter is per-process: effective limit multiplies with workers
issues.body: RateLimiter keeps counters in process memory. We run 4 gunicorn workers, so a client can make up to 120 requests/min instead of 30. Options: move counters to Redis or to the SQLite DB.
issues.author: carol

comments.author: alice
comments.body: SQLite would need write on every request, let's not. Redis is fine but needs infra ticket.

issues.title: Short links with TTL fail right after creation
issues.body: Since the deploy on Oct 15 customers report that links created with a TTL return HTTP 500 when opened, even a minute after creation. Links without TTL work fine.
issues.author: dana-support

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Can't reproduce right away, probably something with the new rate limiter? Will look later.

issues.title: Support custom aliases for short links
issues.body: Allow passing a human-readable alias (e.g. /spring-sale) instead of the generated base62 code. Aliases must not collide with generated codes.
issues.author: erik-marketing

issues.title: CI: pin Python version to 3.12
issues.body: CI picked up a new Python and an unrelated test broke. Pin 3.12 in the CI config.
issues.author: bob

issues.title: Docs: explain link TTL in README
issues.body:
The README does not mention that links can have a TTL. Please add a short section with an example of shorten(url, ttl_hours=24).
